street.note: Street furniture, parked vehicles and named shop fascias are generated from mapped OSM objects and the corridor building directory. Positions are projected source coordinates. Cars and bikes are generic game props without plates or liveries. Shop fascias and shopfront bands are original game lettering and glazing, not photographs. Shopfront bands are omitted on corridor, landmark and civic fronts that already have source-based shop windows. The unnamed covered island at Florastrasse is listed as Bahnhof because it sits under OSM roof way/964266397. Landuse dressing stays inside mapped cemetery, vineyard, allotment, playground, outdoor-seating, pitch, construction and public-pool polygons. School and Hallenbad plaques use OSM names only. Private swimming pools are omitted. Evening window lights are illustrative. Wall colours outside photographed fronts follow OSM type, not a single beige loop.

osm.note: Traffic signals, hydrants, post boxes, fountains and recycling are mapped OSM objects. Props are generated game models, not photographs or working signals. Pitches and zebra crossings stay in the life layer.

geoAdmin.note: House-number plaques use official entrance coordinates for municipality 131. Street-name plates use official street names placed on matching OSM carriageways. NASAK returned no facilities in this envelope; pitch geometry stays OSM. No occupant is attached to an address.

architecture.geometryNote: Positions, normals, indices and walking footprints remain measured-source geometry. Three target UUIDs were matched exactly from hash-verified source tiles. Facade detail is a photographic interpretation from public references, not measured geometry.

architecture.scope: Migros to Soodstrasse 16. Exact UUID and triangle ownership; shared models retain separate address scopes, or one verified profile explicitly covering every part. Photographic and source-tag interpretations identified separately. Surveyed positions, normals, indices, roofs and colliders are preserved.

architecture.geometryNote: Positions, normals, indices and walking footprints remain measured-source geometry. Civic wall ownership uses official collider containment plus an exclusive-vertex guard. Facade detail is a source-based interpretation, not measured window survey.

buildings.note: Official building and roof geometry. Object observation dates vary; tile publication date is not building survey date. Colors use OSM tags where available and a modeled neutral palette otherwise. Procedural facade windows are illustrative, not measured or photographic.

facadeDecoration.method: Union connected, identically oriented wall triangles and their duplicate vertices before measuring one facade interval. Only illustrative facade attributes change; all surveyed geometry is byte-for-byte preserved.
facadeDecoration.note: Connected wall intervals prevent interpolation streaks from quantized per-vertex plane keys. Windows remain artistic decoration.

note: Original Explorer geometry and generated sign textures. Ground uses the bundled Swiss terrain grid; poses can differ slightly from live terrain. Local detailed building UUIDs replace their streamed counterparts only when their models are ready.

source.note: Folded concrete canopy and island platform follow mapped OSM footprints. Height is the OSM roof height, scaled by the game projection. Fold amplitude, pier spacing, timber seats, generated ZVV boards and the hanging clock are stylized interpretations of published exterior photographs and Street View observation. No third-party photograph is bundled as a texture. The canopy is walkable underneath; piers are the only colliders. This is not a survey model and does not open the underground garage.
